text.card: A red giant 4,385 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 17, give 0.83 solar masses and 9.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,976 K at its surface.
